Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
// Generated by tools/build_waypoints.py from waypoints.json: edit that, not this file.
//
// Not Enough Waypoints Uninstaller takes the waypoints of Not Enough Waypoints out of a save:
// load the save once with this mod in place of Not Enough Waypoints, save, then remove this one too.
//
// A save keeps a waypoint in the game's own databases (Shared: _Waypoints.txt) and in the
// travel list of each party that unlocked it. Its objects (the shrine, the arrival point, the
// rune and the boulder) come from the files of Not Enough Waypoints and leave with them.

// The waypoints of Not Enough Waypoints.
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_DEN_Hollow");
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_UND_ArcaneTower");
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_GOB_Sanctum");
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_MOO_MainFloor");
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_WYR_OpenHandTemple");
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall("NEW_WAYP_LOW_Guildhall");

// Not Enough Waypoints keeps the same list in the save. Naming its database here keeps that
// list once the mod is gone, so that a waypoint of a later version is taken out too (the
// game's savegame patches name the databases they read the same way).
NOT DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint("");

KBSECTION
//REGION When a save is loaded
// SavegameLoaded is where the game applies its own savegame patches; LevelGameplayStarted
// covers every level after. Taking a waypoint out twice does nothing.
// Nothing is taken out while Not Enough Waypoints itself is loaded (its goal is running):
// it would keep its objects but lose its waypoints, for good, since its story only adds
// them when it first starts in a save.
IF
SavegameLoaded()
AND
NOT SysIsActive("NotEnoughWaypoints")
THEN
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall();

IF
LevelGameplayStarted(_, _)
AND
NOT SysIsActive("NotEnoughWaypoints")
THEN
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall();

PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall()
AND
DB_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall(_ID)
THEN
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Remove(_ID);

PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Uninstall()
AND
DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint(_ID)
THEN
NOT DB_NEW_WAYP_Waypoint(_ID);
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Remove(_ID);
//END_REGION

//REGION One waypoint
// Locked the way the story locks a waypoint when its act ends, which takes it out of the travel
// list of every party that has it, then forgotten. In this order: the lock needs the waypoint.
PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Remove((STRING)_ID)
AND
DB_WaypointInfo(_Group, _ID, _Shrine, _Trigger)
THEN
PROC_LockWaypointForAll(_ID);
PROC_NEW_WAYP_ForgetUnlocks(_ID);
NOT DB_WaypointInfo(_Group, _ID, _Shrine, _Trigger);

// The lock forgets who unlocked it among the players; this, everyone else.
PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_ForgetUnlocks((STRING)_ID)
AND
DB_WaypointUnlocked(_ID, _Character)
THEN
NOT DB_WaypointUnlocked(_ID, _Character);

// Sovereign Glut's list of Underdark waypoints.
PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Remove((STRING)_ID)
AND
DB_UND_BroodingSpovereign_UnderdarkWaypoints(_ID)
THEN
NOT DB_UND_BroodingSpovereign_UnderdarkWaypoints(_ID);

// Which waypoint an arrival point belongs to, remembered after travel from another level.
PROC
PROC_NEW_WAYP_Remove((STRING)_ID)
AND
DB_QRYRTN_Waypoints_IDFromString(_Trigger, _ID)
THEN
NOT DB_QRYRTN_Waypoints_IDFromString(_Trigger, _ID);
//END_REGION
EXITSECTION

ENDEXITSECTION
